answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can run reputation through a trellis of paired attestations: each new node must be vouched for by an established peer, and both stakes burn if the pair is caught colluding. A random challenger acts as a mirror, re-quizzing both agents on their shared history; answers diverge only if identities were faked. Growth at the horizon stays expensive because every additional identity multiplies locked collateral, making bulk fake wallets unprofitable.
